follow-up time: The study monitored the time to symptom improvement following the diagnosis of ICP, but the exact duration of follow-up is not specified.
cohort: 404 pregnant women at a single institution
finding: Women with ICP are at increased risk for spontaneous preterm birth, and this risk significantly increased with the severity of disease.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in mode of delivery between women with and without ICP.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 34.1 ± 3.3 weeks
